message.content:
An illustration serves as the cover for "TEMPO" magazine. Two figures, a man and a woman, are depicted from the waist up against a white background. The man on the left wears a light-colored, buttoned-up tunic with a stethoscope draped around his neck. He has short dark hair and wears glasses, looking toward the right. His hands grip a tall bamboo pole that extends diagonally across the frame. The woman on the right wears a white lab coat over a blue garment, with another stethoscope around her neck. Her hair is pulled back, and she also looks toward the right. 

Attached to the top of the bamboo pole is a large, flowing two-colored flag—red on top and white below—that waves behind the figures. Above the masthead "TEMPO," text reads "Edisi Khusus Kemerdekaan." Below the masthead, smaller text says "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Large text in the lower left states "JEJAK DOKTER LEGENDARIS," followed by a paragraph in Indonesian. A barcode, QR code, and date "17-23 AGUSTUS 2020" are visible in the bottom right corner.
